name: [CHAPTER 2] Voice Control 🔊
desc:
🔥Welcome to Voice Control Obby 🔥
Use your in-game microphone to jump and navigate through challenging obstacles as you ascend the mountain. Shout, sing, or speak to control your movements.

📌Voice chat is required for this game!
🔊Use your microphone to jump! 
🎤The longer you speak the higher you go! 

👉Join the official group for in-game rewards! https://www.roblox.com/groups/33458381/RunUp-Studios
